doc.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing thanks
summary: The interview ends with thanks and good wishes for his projects.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has really been fascinating. I’ve been looking forward to talking to you.
Thank you, it’s been a great pleasure.
And I wish you the best with your myriad of projects, and working on your vowels and the consonants.
Oh, so much to do, so little time. So much to do, so little time. See there was no b’s in there. Anyway thank you very much, Monk, appreciate it.
Okay. Thanks for your time. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -16-
